entries.132b76136af871c2: [[term:annual-securities-report|Annual securities report]] states that, under its corporate mission “Magical, New Experiences,” the company operates in the entertainment domain, centered on running the VTuber group Nijisanji, as a single segment of video content-related business. Its business consists of four domains: the live streaming domain, centered on live broadcasts on YouTube; the commerce domain, which sells goods and digital products; the event domain, which hosts events featuring VTubers; and the promotion domain, which covers corporate tie-up advertising and IP licensing. In addition, there is an other domain, which includes VTuber business in China. Revenue for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥55,681 million: ¥38,092 million in the commerce domain, ¥7,874 million in the promotion domain, ¥5,601 million in the live streaming domain, ¥4,087 million in the event domain and ¥26 million in the other domain. The figures are all those of the company on a non-consolidated basis, as no consolidated financial statements are prepared.
entries.2beccf9ad8f9f279: Through two-way communication with VTubers, the company builds fan communities and, as points of contact, provides sales of goods and digital products, events featuring VTubers, and promotion for customer companies.

entries.33cbb441a30a7ecc: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥20,172 million (up 23.9% year on year), ordinary profit was ¥20,197 million (up 24.6%), and net income was ¥14,091 million (up 22.4%). Cost of sales was ¥30,815 million (up 35.3%). The annual securities report cites as the main causes higher production costs and fees paid, arising from changes in the method of valuing inventories, expanded support for affiliated VTubers, a focus on content domains such as physical and digital goods, and the expansion of the promotion domain using VTubers. The company pays livers a portion of the revenue from each VTuber’s YouTube channel and content revenue, among other sources.

entries.81d389f5bb99f4d8: An area that sells the Company's original merchandise, digital products recording VTubers' voices, music and similar items, and has the largest sales of the 5 areas. Sales for the fiscal year ended April 2026 were ¥38,092 million (up 36.8% year on year). Sales are made mainly through the official online store "NIJISANJI Official Store" and at event venues organized by the Company, and the official fan club "NIJISANJI FAN CLUB," launched in October 2020, provides paid services such as chat functions among fans and between fans and VTubers. The Company plans, designs and places orders for the production of the content it sells. Purchases in the fiscal year under review were ¥9,309 million (up 10.2% year on year), and the commerce area is the only area for which purchase results are given.
entries.82c4794223f3d0af: Fans (viewers of live broadcasts and users of Nijisanji Official Store and Nijisanji FAN CLUB)
entries.82ddf9c63053022f: An area that organizes events, including music events, featuring VTubers belonging to the Company. Sales for the fiscal year ended April 2026 were ¥4,087 million (up 44.9% year on year). In the fiscal year under review, from May 10, 2025 to April 11, 2026, over about 1 year, the Company held "NIJISANJI WORLD TOUR 2025 Singin' in the Rainbow!" in multiple major cities including overseas, commemorating the 7th anniversary of "NIJISANJI." The Company plans the events and carries out production in cooperation with external event production companies. Revenue includes ticket income and similar items, and for co-hosted events the amount is recorded multiplied by the co-hosting ratio.
entries.94b510fe02aa2001: Original goods, digital products that record VTubers’ voices, music, and the fan club Nijisanji FAN CLUB (commerce domain)
entries.952021ebd694c37e: An area that promotes client companies' products and services using the VTuber IP held by the Company. Sales for the fiscal year ended April 2026 were ¥7,874 million (up 11.5% year on year). Revenue comes mainly from 3 sources: tie-up advertising, IP licensing and media appearances. These are, respectively, VTubers introducing products in videos and similar content in return for payment, granting permission to use the IP in return for royalties, and VTubers appearing on client companies' media such as television and radio in return for appearance fees. The Company proposes the use of VTuber IP to client companies and, after receiving an order, acts as an intermediary between the client company and the VTuber to support implementation.
entries.9715e8804e992204: Customer companies for tie-up advertising and IP licensing (promotion domain)
entries.9e79e5d7ef3227e7: Revenue for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥55,681 million, up 29.9% from ¥42,876 million in the prior year. The annual securities report cites as drivers of revenue growth the increase in affiliated VTubers and the expansion of support systems, which increased the number of fans and led the commerce domain to grow substantially, and the broader scope of VTuber activities, which increased requests for corporate projects and led the promotion domain to grow substantially. For Super Chat and YouTube memberships in the live streaming domain, the company receives amounts net of fees paid to Google LLC, but in its financial statements it records the gross amount as revenue and the fees as expenses.

entries.a9da03296b2c1930: The Company's only reportable segment, whose main business is operating the VTuber group "NIJISANJI." The securities report states that because the Company has a single segment, the video content related business, segment-by-segment information is omitted and sales results by business area are given instead. Net sales for the fiscal year ended April 2026 were ¥55,681 million (up 29.9% year on year) and operating profit was ¥20,172 million (up 23.9%). A VTuber is an entity in which a real person, called a Liver, is replaced by a virtual character using motion capture technology to conduct video streaming. The number of VTubers belonging to "NIJISANJI" and "NIJISANJI EN" was 179 in the fiscal year ended April 2026 (up 9 from the same period of the previous year). The Company itself designs the VTuber characters, holds the intellectual property (IP) related to the VTubers, and enters into outsourcing agreements with Livers. The business consists of 4 areas: live streaming, commerce, events and promotion, and the VTuber business in China and other activities are included in the other area. The securities report states that the commerce area and the promotion area are mainly driving growth in net sales.

entries.fa892d259cce48ce: An area in which VTubers stream live on video platforms such as YouTube and communicate interactively through the chat function. Sales for the fiscal year ended April 2026 were ¥5,601 million (up 10.8% year on year). Revenue consists mainly of 3 sources: Super Chat, YouTube memberships and Google AdSense revenue. The securities report states that for Super Chat and YouTube memberships, the Company receives the net amount after deducting fees to Google LLC, but in the financial statements the gross amount is recorded as revenue and the fees are recorded as expenses, whereas Google AdSense is recorded as revenue at the net amount. A new VTuber is played by a Liver selected from applicants to auditions held by the Company, with the character settings designed by the Company.
